standards.name: ODS AI-Assisted Code Governance
standards.description: Deterministic, artifact-level requirements for governing AI-assisted changes: disclosure, evidence grading, diff-scoped test adequacy, policy evaluation, and pipeline integrity.

requirements.title: AI involvement is disclosed
requirements.text: When AI assistance is detected, author or tool attribution is present (commit trailer, PR-body disclosure, or git-ai notes).

requirements.title: Attribution strength is graded
requirements.text: The change carries an evidence tier stating how attribution was obtained: corroborated (measured), attested (declared), inferred (heuristic), or inconclusive.

requirements.title: Changed code is exercised by tests
requirements.text: Source changes are accompanied by test changes, and the diff's added lines are covered (patch coverage) to the project's threshold.

requirements.title: Tests detect faults in the added lines
requirements.text: Mutants injected on the diff's added lines are killed by the test suite (diff-scoped mutation score) to the project's threshold.

requirements.title: Policy was evaluated and the change routed
requirements.text: The organization's OPA policy evaluated the change (allowed/denied) and produced a review-routing tier.

requirements.title: Pipeline integrity
requirements.text: Every pipeline stage (detect, analyze, score, check) completed; no stage result was substituted for a failure.
